If You Can’t Move

I realize that for most people reading this there are a lot of reasons why they can't just head off and go build community on some land. Jobs, kids, pets, debt, a mortgage, a sick parent, or several of these arranged in a circle... That's fine! The most important pl/ork doesn't need land anyway.

Too bad you can’t move…

People sometimes buy forty acres and then bring all their unprocessed stuff with them to a more scenic location. It's a more beautiful view for sure, but now you have the conflict PLUS goats.

So your inner pl/ork can start now, right where you live. Peer counseling takes two people and a private place to sit and talk. That's it! And reparenting, somatic work, jealousy work, conflict repair, etc etc? None of it has to wait until somebody has a deed in hand.

Here's an idea if you're remote, or stuck where you are: build the part of it you actually can. Have a weekly meal with two households. Set up a counseling exchange with one friend, in person or by video. Share tools or childcare. Transport or food prep work too. Or a sauna! And if you're hippie enough, add acro-yoga, dance improv, a mothers' circle or a cuddle puddle.
